about_the_game:
Take on iconic worlds and your favourite franchises with SpecialEffect's Streamer Bear! With your purchase, you'll be supporting the UK charity, SpecialEffect, and helping to level the playing field for people with physical disabilities.

70% of all revenue from the SpecialEffect Streamer Bear DLC will be donated to SpecialEffect org uk Ltd (Charity number 1121004)

For more information about SpecialEffect and the fantastic work that they do, please visit their main website.
